description: The file is a Java source file implementing a REST controller (QuestionController) for managing Question entities. It provides CRUD endpoints with pagination support, includes Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for API documentation, and depends on Spring Boot framework components such as annotations, dependency injection, and request mappings.

classes.name: QuestionController
classes.description: REST controller providing endpoints for CRUD operations on Question entities, with pagination and Swagger API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getQuestions
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all questions from the repository.

methods.name: createQuestion
methods.description: Creates a new question in the repository with provided details.

methods.name: updateQuestion
methods.description: Updates an existing question identified by ID with new data.

methods.name: deleteQuestion
methods.description: Deletes a question by its ID.
